title: Asymptotic and pre-asymptotic convergence of sparse grids for anisotropic kernel interpolation
summary: Sparse grids are popular tools for high-dimensional function approximation. In this work, we study the use of sparse grids for interpolation using separable Matérn kernels $Φ_{\boldsymbolν,\boldsymbolλ}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{x}')=\prod_{j=1}^dφ_{ν_j,λ_j}(x_j,x_j')$, with a particular focus on the anisotropic setting where the regularity $ν_j$ and the lengthscale $λ_j$ vary with dimension $j$.
